book.name: 1 Timothy
book.title: 1 TIMOTHY PAUL AN FEF AINAUIN IGAYAM TIMOTHY AURIN

content: Atonio dura abikakafun on dura bag: Orot iyafan egogoi ekalesia asi bainetewarotin inmatar on, egogoi bobo obin wat inafour.

Ekalesia asi bainetewarotin on men an komasin auman mes; on awan kaitamom wat, on an not on totorinai wat ininonot, on toun initotorai tiwag, on sabu sinkakafai; on sabu inikakaiwis inboes an goai iniwanis; on on fofonin sabu inibebeyes;
on men sareu wawanis intoman kwakwan inikokok mes, o on men baigagamotin mes, baise on rutanobin a tuf an orot; on men agim ininuaboai mes;
On toun awan nanatun on inkaifares tiwag a on iniyamai toun nanatun on tamas fonan sinboai sinkakafai.
Ato orot men isagob mamaba awan nanatun inkaifares on, ato on mamaba arimon God an ekalesia inkaifares?
On orot on men ato arimon inbosuruf inbitutum mes, on bobo nanaba infofour on arimon toun ingememenai ato God arimon on inimakiai ato Afaguban ibimakiai ba.
Sabu koun yangan men ekalesia amonai semama mat on ato orot sinkakafai, osi sabu men on bobo nanaba aurin sinfofour on arimon sinimamaiai ato siniyamai Afaguban an egirafai inafeu.

Ekalesia asi baibaisotis mat on eb asi bobo asi yawas on obinai wat sinafour a osi men baisigogo’otis mes; osi men sareu wine sintoman kwakwan mes a osi men asi faiwar siniyamai agim sawar auris sindadan kwakwan mes;
osi asi baitutum on nana sinbotan a asi not totorinai wat dura maiauin sinboai singat.
Osi ekalesia asi baibaisotis on ainau asi yawas unrutobonen uneit ato osi on rutobon sinsosowar on, osi asi bobo sinabo.
Osi ekalesia asi baibaisotis awawas mat on eb asi yawas obin wat sinafour a osi men sinyanu mes; osi asi not totorinai wat a asi boboai nan on sabu sinites sinitutum.
Ekalesia an baibaisotin awan on kaitamom wat, a on fofonin awan a nanatun on obinai wat inkaifares.

Osi ekalesia asi baibaisotis asi bobo obin wat sefofour on, ekalesia yangan on arimon osi wabis obin aurin on sinikakafunai a asi baitutum Keriso Iesuai sinyein on fofonin dura totor wat sinkurereb men sinaber mes.
Yau atonio fef om aurim agagayam on, yau anonosin kafakakai mom annat anitem.

Baise yau mamaba men gariwat annanat on, atonio fef on iniyoboem ot tout ati bobo on mamaba ekalesia an bobo tanabo God an dam warar auris on, ato osi dam warar min God yayawasin an ekalesia On wantoan emama, ekalesia yangan on God an dura maiauin on osi asi tutut a asi kufaiwar.
Ot ati baitutum buburin gagamin aurin on men iyafan tani inisosouf mes.

content.text: Iesu Keriso on orot maiauin imatar usit ba ibo irobotet ato aurit igat iyoboet, ato On an Ayu iyoboet On an yawas on totorin wat, ato anea min On sit. Sabu sanasi nan On an dura on sikurereb, ato sabu tafanam engon tutufinai On situtumai ato On igai au safam God rus sininetewar.
